hero.h1Start: IS Metal Industry — precision, engineering and trust in
hero.lead: We were born to manufacture measurement towers and deliver high-precision solutions for wind and solar. Today we operate end-to-end — from manufacturing to field operations — with certified processes.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: IS Metal Industry was founded with a clear purpose: to manufacture towers for wind measurement campaigns and provide the renewable energy market with high-precision, reliable solutions.
story.p2: From the beginning, our structures were designed for data performance, incorporating engineering concepts to reduce interferences caused by wind vortices.
story.p3: Over nearly two decades, we have grown with the wind and solar sectors. We manufacture guyed and self-supporting towers, perform instrumentation, commissioning and maintenance, and cover the full cycle of anemometric and solarimetric data monitoring and acquisition.
story.p4: With ISO 9001-certified processes and practices aligned with ESG principles, we remain committed to a more efficient and sustainable energy sector.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: Develop, produce and market solutions and innovations in metal structures, assembly and maintenance; safe dismantling and controlled toppling of anemometric towers, delivering excellence and safety.

items.q: How do we provide digital dossiers?
items.a: We deliver per-project dossiers (PDF) including material traceability, inspections, NDT, photo records and painting reports — all linked to the purchase/work order.

items.q: Which processes are covered by the certificates?
items.a: Design & manufacturing, industrial painting, field instrumentation & commissioning, maintenance and supplier management — within our IMS.
Yes. We welcome client audits and technical visits, with action plans and follow-up until completion.
